notes.title: Update 0.4 is Live!
notes.notes:
- New map and environment : The Pit. Neo tactical style! Should be fun to play.
- New 2021 World Cup Layout @Kissimmee
- New vaulting animation over the snake (hold jump key when crouched next to the snake with gun in the proper hand). Not yet functional with hyperball.
- Clan TAG added (optional). 3 letters max, can be set in customize section.
- Your stats are now highlighted in the scoreboard
- Dye Rotor R2, Dye MXR, and Push goggles added (only a couple colorways for now).
- Faster buzzer animation
- Strafe run gun position changed
- Strafe run accuracy lowered
- Using lower gun key to raise gun faster off break glitch : fixed
- +5 seconds added to map selection vote
- Name of the person initiating vote added
- New vote input : Hold Start/Enter to vote YES, tap for NO
- Stamina is not depleting if you don't move (but won't recharge if you hold the run key)
- Snapshot angle too high when prone in some cases (Short character or skinny) : fixed
- Wrong color loaded on gun : To be tested but should be fixed
- Game stuck with cursor on screen after changing team : fixed

[img]https://i.ibb.co/bJ7c0Ch/The-Pit-Preview-1.png[/img]
